title: 2027 Honda CR-V Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Honda CR-V is a carryover model, following a mild update for 2026. A more substantial overhaul could be due for 2028.
body_markdown:
The Honda CR-V is the Japanese brand’s best-selling model in the United States and it’s easy to see why, because it offers an excellent blend of usefulness, reliability, fuel efficiency, and driving enjoyment. Rumor has it that a redesigned CR-V is due for the 2028 model year, but the 2027 version is definitely worth considering for buyers looking for a solid compact crossover.

## What’s New for the 2027 Honda CR-V


Now in its sixth generation, the Honda CR-V was last redesigned in 2023 and is the Japanese brand's best-selling vehicle. For 2026, it received a new rugged-looking TrailSport trim level along with enhancements to its interior displays and technologies. There aren’t any major changes for the 2027 model year. As before, the 2027 CR-V is offered in both regular gasoline and hybrid forms. We cover the[2027 CR-V Hybrid](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/2027-honda-cr-v-hybrid-price-specs-release-date) separately.


## Design


The Honda CR-V is an attractive car with boxy styling and clean lines. It shares a clear family resemblance to the larger Pilot and Passport SUVs, but offers the rugged appearance in a smaller package. The CR-V is available in several trim levels, with LX, EX, and EX-L being the only trims available with the gas model. LX models come with 17-inch wheels, while the EX and EX-L trim levels get 18-inch alloy wheels. The hybrid version (pictured) has distinct Sport Hybrid, TrailSport Hybrid, Sport-L Hybrid, and Sport Touring Hybrid trim levels.


## Powertrain


CR-V LX, EX, and EX-L models are equipped with a 1.5-liter turbocharged four-cylinder engine that produces 190 horsepower and 179 pound-feet of torque. It’s mated to a continuously variable transmission (CVT) and can be optioned with front-wheel drive (FWD) or all-wheel drive (AWD). In its most efficient FWD form, this powertrain delivers 28 mpg in the city, 33 mpg on the highway, and 30 mpg combined. Non-hybrid CR-Vs can tow up to 1,500 pounds.


## Interior


The CR-V’s straightforward interior is highly functional but unexciting. Material quality is good, with the mesh-like finish that extends from the center of the dashboard to the passenger side door panel standing out as an interesting design flourish. Cloth upholstery comes standard, and leather is included with the EX-L trim. There’s a good amount of room inside for occupants and cargo. The 2027 CR-V is competitive but not class-leading for load capacity, with 39.3 cubic feet of space behind the rear seat or up to 76.5 cubic feet of space with the rear seat folded flat.


## Technology


The 2027 Honda CR-V comes standard with a 9-inch touchscreen located atop the center of the dashboard that runs relatively simple infotainment software. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity are standard. There are two physical buttons on the left side of the touchscreen. A Home button brings the infotainment back to its main screen and the second button is used to bring up smartphone projection. There’s also a physical volume knob. A 7-inch display in the gauge cluster is standard on LX and EX models, while EX-L models have a 10.2-inch digital gauge cluster. CR-V LX models have a 160-watt audio system with four speakers. The EX has a 240-watt system with six speakers and the EX-L trim features a 320-watt system with eight speakers.

## Safety


Adaptive cruise control, automatic emergency braking, lane-keep assist, lane-departure warning, traffic-sign recognition, and high-beam assist are standard on all 2027 CR-V models. Blind-spot monitors and a rear cross-traffic alert are added starting at the EX trim level. The 2027 CR-V received Good ratings in the small overlap front and updated side crash tests from the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety, but a Poor rating in the updated moderate front overlap test. The 2026 CR-V, which is mechanically the same as the 2027 model, received the top five-star safety rating from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2027 Honda CR-V starts at $33,070 (including destination) in base LX trim with FWD. Opting for AWD adds $1,500. The EX trim level starts at $35,100, and the EX-L at $37,350. An HPD Package adds a tailgate spoiler, trim accents at the front and rear, and fender flares for $1,607. For $1,852, a Utility Package adds roof rails, crossbars, running boards, a trailer hitch, and a seat back protector.
